traceability.notes: docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md defines an ESLint rule that enforces traceability annotations on significant code branches. The rule `traceability/require-branch-annotation` and its utilities are implemented in src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts and src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts. Tests verify detection of missing annotations across all relevant branch types, support for @supports as an alternative to @story/@req, nested and formatter-driven layouts (including catch and else-if), configurable branch scope, and performance on large files. The rule is wired into the plugin’s exported rules and flat-config presets, and user-facing documentation under docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md describes behavior and configuration with examples. The full Jest suite passes, including all tests tagged for this story and its helpers. All acceptance criteria and technical requirements in the story are met, so this story is fully implemented.
